svg.text: 1. Dimensions in mm. Third-angle projection. Scale 1:6 on A3.
2. Datum: origin at wing LE, span centreline, chord line;
+X aft, +Y right tip, +Z wing top (pod side).
3. Hidden lines removed (depth-buffer HLR of the Fusion
mesh export). Prop discs shown as phantom lines.
static margin 5.0 % MAC. CG shown on centreline.
5. Motor numbering ArduPilot quad-X tailsitter; rotation
as seen from the nose. Diagonal pairs counter-rotate.
±30° throw. Fins 6 mm Depron at y = ±320.
7. Mass 1982 g (BOM sheet 3, incl. skin and adhesive).
